Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥502 million. For newborn photography, Shichi-Go-San and other children's milestones and events, users can book a preferred photographer by specifying time and location and have family commemorative photos taken. When materials are sold, creators are granted acquired credits according to the sales price and commission rate.
